critical_findings.title: cosmoflare dev proxy is a stub but documented as functional
critical_findings.fix: Implement the per-service reverse proxy with profile-resolved credentials and fsnotify config watch, or remove the command/options and correct docs/USAGE.md to match current behavior

critical_findings.title: No HTTP timeout on cloudflare-go transport in 27 FromCreds constructors (http.DefaultClient fallback)
critical_findings.fix: Pass a package-default http.Client{Timeout: 30s} via cloudflare.HTTPClient in every NewXServiceFromCreds; document the single timeout policy

critical_findings.title: Daemon REST handlers accept any HTTP method (no 405 enforcement)
critical_findings.fix: Add a GET-only guard (405 for other verbs) in authMiddleware or a wrapper applied to all routes

critical_findings.title: Daemon-to-desktop wire contract untyped (any in ServeSource and MetricsSnapshot, unchecked cast in TS client)
critical_findings.fix: Return concrete typed structs from ServeSource methods and generate TypeScript types for desktop/src/api from Go definitions

critical_findings.title: Exported public retry API (retry.Do) is unwired dead code
critical_findings.fix: Unexport or delete the retry helper package; restClient already implements superior Retry-After-aware retry

critical_findings.title: Split product identity: r2go2 vs cosmoflare across public API surface
critical_findings.fix: Fix stale doc comments (Package r2go2, .r2go2.yaml on ProjectConfig); plan error-prefix rename to cosmoflare: and ~/.cosmoflare machine-config path with read fallback

critical_findings.title: Inconsistent error content types (text/plain 401/503 vs application/json) and non-constant-time token comparison with ?token= query fallback
critical_findings.fix: Route all error paths through writeJSONStatus; use subtle.ConstantTimeCompare for the bearer token check

critical_findings.title: Token config file written at default perms then chmod'd to 0600; isNotFound classifies errors by substring matching
critical_findings.fix: Write machine config atomically at 0600 (temp file + rename); restrict isNotFound string fallback to library-produced R2Error messages

recommendations.action: Implement or remove the cosmoflare dev proxy; correct USAGE.md until then
Thread a timeout-bearing http.Client through all NewXServiceFromCreds constructors
Reject non-GET methods with 405 on all daemon REST routes
Type the daemon wire contract (concrete Go structs) and generate TS types for the desktop client
Unexport/delete the unwired retry.go public API
Unify naming: fix stale r2go2 doc comments, plan error-prefix and machine-config path migration
Use writeJSONStatus for 503/401 error paths and constant-time token comparison
Write machine config atomically at 0600 permissions
Document a Go API compatibility policy for the public pkg/cosmoflare library

roadmap_suggestions.title: Dev server: real proxy or removal
roadmap_suggestions.description: cosmoflare dev currently returns 502 for every request while USAGE.md documents a working proxy with config hot-reload; implement per-service proxying or deprecate the command

roadmap_suggestions.title: Unified transport resilience policy
roadmap_suggestions.description: One timeout/retry/backoff policy across the three transports (R2 client, restClient, cloudflare-go path), configurable via ClientOption and documented once

roadmap_suggestions.title: Typed daemon wire contract with TS codegen
roadmap_suggestions.description: Concrete Go response structs for all daemon REST/SSE payloads with generated TypeScript types in desktop/src/api, drift-checked in CI

roadmap_suggestions.title: Public library v1 readiness
roadmap_suggestions.description: Compat policy doc, cosmoflare identity cleanup, dead exported API removal ahead of a 1.0 of pkg/cosmoflare
